texts.greeting: Hello! Write your question here and our team will answer in this chat. /status shows your request, /close closes it.
texts.received: Thank you, your request #{id} is received. We will reply here.
texts.status_open: Your request #{id} is open. Just write here to add details.
texts.status_none: You have no open requests. Write your question to open one.
texts.closed_by_you: Request #{id} is closed. Write again any time.
texts.staff_help: Reply to a ticket message to answer the customer. Commands: /open, /ticket N, /reply N text, /close N, /reopen N.
texts.bad_ticket: Ticket not found. Use a number from /open.
texts.reply_hint: To answer a customer, reply to the ticket message or use /reply N text.
texts.not_delivered: Could not deliver to ticket #{id} (the customer may have blocked the bot).
